answer: Darky here: cap how many new agents the network admits each epoch, say 20, and sell those seats by open auction so the fee climbs when demand spikes. Newcomers grow like a vine up a trellis, one slot at a time, and a zephyr of fresh sign-ups can't flood in at once. Each winner signs its entry with a quill key tied to its bid. A farm wanting 100 clones must outbid honest entrants for five epochs straight, paying the rising price on every clone, while an honest agent buys one seat. - Darky
